advanced.title: Advanced settings.js
advanced.description: Edit the live settings.js file detected by nrcc. A backup is created automatically before saving.
advanced.unlockDialogDescription: This change is written directly to the host settings.js file ({{backupPath}}). A backup is taken automatically before saving. A syntax error in settings.js can prevent Node-RED from starting, which would take the orchestrator offline.
advanced.unlockAcknowledgement: I understand that a bad save can break Node-RED startup.
advanced.lockedBadge: Locked - click "Unlock to edit" to make changes

preset.acknowledgement: I understand that confirming a preset will rewrite the managed key in settings.js and the original managed value cannot be recovered unless a backup exists.
preset.title: Curated presets
preset.description: Vetted high-value recipes for advanced Node-RED 5 settings. Each preset declares the editor / HTTP / Socket.IO surfaces it touches and never rewrites operator-owned code outside its declared scope.
preset.reviewDiff: Review the redacted diff. Confirm to write the patched source through /api/settings/raw (or cancel to discard).

aiProviderDesc: Configure optional, review-first AI flow assistance.
controlsUnavailable: Configuration controls are unavailable for this runtime. Review the detected settings below.
rotateSecretDescription: Saving a new credential secret invalidates the encryption of every stored credential. Existing flows with encrypted credentials will need to be re-entered or restored from a backup taken before this rotation. Continue only if you understand the impact.
rotateSecretAcknowledgement: I understand that existing encrypted credentials must be re-entered after this rotation.

securityCenter.title: Security Center
securityCenter.subtitle: Passwords and bcrypt hashes are never shown. Leave a password blank to preserve its existing value.
securityCenter.previewBody: Canonical surfaces: adminAuth, httpNodeAuth, and httpStaticAuth. Credential values, hashes, and passwords are redacted.
securityCenter.readOnly: Security Center is read-only because this runtime configuration is not editable.
securityCenter.legacyBody: Saving will migrate {{aliases}} to the canonical surfaces. Secrets remain redacted.
securityCenter.bcryptHint: Leave blank to preserve the existing hash. New values must be bcrypt hashes and are never displayed.

dashboardAccess.title: Dashboard Access
dashboardAccess.subtitle: Configure a reviewed access policy without exposing credentials.
dashboardAccess.previewBody: Target: {{target}}. Recipe: {{recipe}}. Credentials, hashes, and authorization values are never shown.
dashboardAccess.readOnly: Dashboard Access is read-only because this runtime configuration is not editable.
